# Disposable image transport fixture

`fixture.tar.gz` and `receipt.json` are synthetic, public test data generated by
`main.mjs` with installed headless Chrome for Testing. The 36 filenames exercise
the closed engine/device/game binding matrix; **all actual fixture captures are
Chromium**, as `browser.json` explicitly records. They prove neither WebKit nor
native/physical device acceptance. One Shikaku frame has a red privacy panel
covering Undo/Redo despite the fixture's declared passing source checks.

The opt-in `TestNativeExperienceImageReview` stages this fixture through a real
declared command artifact, attaches all images to one read-only Sol/xhigh turn,
and requires the independent judgment to identify that obstruction. Its fresh
private evidence directory and durable turn receipt prevent silent replay.
Normal tests use no model and validate authenticity, bounds and fail-closed gates.

To regenerate, pass absolute installed Playwright module and Chrome for Testing
executable paths, plus an owned output directory:

```sh
node testdata/experience/main.mjs PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE CHROME_FOR_TESTING OUTPUT
```

No runtime download or personal browser is used. Review generated evidence before
replacing these two golden files. Keep the generator's `capture.json` in the
private qualification evidence, rather than duplicating it in source.
